spanish: Y sobrante el excedente en las cortinas de la tienda, mitad de la cortina la excedente sobrará sobre detrás del tabernáculo.
grammarChanges: Removed the unwarranted definite article before anarthrous 'sobrante' (h02026012001).
Added the definite article in 'en las cortinas de la tienda' for the definite construct chain (h02026012003-h02026012004).
Replaced the noun 'espalda' with the preposition 'detrás' so h02026012010 stays a preposition, not a body-part noun.
Translated the common noun הַמִּשְׁכָּן (h02026012011) as 'tabernáculo' instead of leaving the lemma as 'mishkán'.
readerNote: Chose 'sobre detrás del tabernáculo' to render עַל אֲחֹרֵי as two stacked prepositions rather than renaming אֲחֹרֵי into a noun like 'espalda' or 'parte posterior'.
